Deidoro Sakaki.name: Deidoro Sakaki
Deidoro Sakaki.basicInfo:
Deidoro Sakaki, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers: a loud, quick-tempered drinker whose Quirk throws nearby opponents off balance. Bony and muscular, long black hair, a plain mask, a shaggy vest; a sake bottle in hand.
Speaking Style: Energetic and quick to anger; his speech slurs while he drinks.
Combat Role: Disruptor: leaves nearby opponents dizzy, so he and his allies can hit people who cannot stand straight.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and angrier, and drinks more.
Deidoro Sakaki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Loud and unsteady himself, he is most dangerous when others cannot keep their feet. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the head he serves; the other Eight Bullets. Knowledge: The tunnels and his orders; the plan only in outline. Thread: Whether an opponent can stay upright long enough to reach him.
QUIRK: Sloshed. Leaves opponents near him dizzy and off balance; it touches balance, not minds.
personality: Hot-tempered: Flares up fast and stays angry.
Restless: Loud and on the move even mid-fight.
Drinker: Drinks through a confrontation and slurs more as it goes.
Speaking style: Energetic, angry, slurred while he drinks.
abilities: Sloshed: Leaves nearby opponents dizzy and off balance; it affects balance, not minds, and needs them close.
Brawling: Hits reeling opponents hard; against someone who keeps their footing he is an ordinary thug.
Fighting style: Closes in, staggers the opponents nearby with Sloshed, and strikes while they reel.
Deidoro Sakaki.visualDescription: A bony but muscular man with long, straight black hair, narrow eyes and a flushed face, a plain dark mask over his nose and mouth. He wears a shaggy fur vest over a dark shirt and dark trousers, and carries a large ceramic sake bottle in one hand. A loud, quarrelsome, half-drunk expression, his eyes bright and unfocused.
